shelters.name: Seattle Humane
shelters.description: Founded in 1897. Served over 113,000 pets in fiscal year 2024. Open-door shelter with no time limits. Offers pet food bank, low-cost spay/neuter, and humane education.

shelters.name: Humane Society for Tacoma & Pierce County
shelters.description: Serving Tacoma and Pierce County with animal rescue, shelter, and adoption services.

shelters.name: Spokane Humane Society
shelters.description: Shelters, cares for, and advocates for companion animals in greater Spokane since 1897. Operates low-income veterinary clinic.

shelters.name: PAWS
shelters.description: People helping cats, dogs and wild animals go home and thrive. Operates new PAWS Wildlife Center in southwest Snohomish County.

shelters.name: Auburn Valley Humane Society
shelters.description: Local, independent 501(c)(3) non-profit enriching lives of companion animals and people through animal sheltering, programs and community engagement.

shelters.name: Pasado's Safe Haven
shelters.description: Rescues, shelters, and rehomes animals who suffered abuse and neglect. GFAS-accredited sanctuary in the foothills of the Cascade Mountains.

shelters.name: Homeward Pet Adoption Center
shelters.description: No-kill, non-profit animal shelter serving greater Seattle area. Gives homeless animals a second chance through rescue, shelter, and adoption.

shelters.name: Kitsap Humane Society
shelters.description: Animal welfare organization providing shelter, rehabilitation, and adoption services to animals in Kitsap County.

shelters.name: Humane Society for Southwest Washington
shelters.description: Caring for animals in the community since 1897.

shelters.name: Purrfect Pals
shelters.description: Works to end cat homelessness in Puget Sound region through placement, prevention, and low-income resources for special needs cats.

shelters.name: Old Dog Haven
shelters.description: Group of private homes caring for senior dogs all over western Washington.

shelters.name: Spokanimal Care
shelters.description: Advocates for animal rights through veterinary care, education, and legislation. Offers transport programs and low-cost sterilization services.

shelters.name: Seattle Animal Shelter
shelters.description: City of Seattle's official animal shelter providing animal services and adoptions.

shelters.name: Regional Animal Services of King County
shelters.description: Regional animal services for King County providing sheltering and adoption services.

shelters.name: Wenatchee Valley Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Wenatchee Valley and central Washington.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Washington state animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. Seattle Humane (founded 1897) served over 113,000 pets in 2024. Spokane Humane Society also since 1897. Pasado's Safe Haven is GFAS-accredited sanctuary. Coverage spans Seattle, Tacoma, Spokane, Vancouver, and surrounding areas.
